name: Mem0 v2 AI Memory Layer
description: Persistent memory for AI agents: REST API, dashboard and pgvector storage.

upstream.version: v2.2.1 (server/ and server/dashboard/ at tag v2.2.1, mem0ai[nlp]==2.2.1)

Mem0 API.preDeployCommand: sh -c 'cd /app && python railway/prepare_db.py && alembic upgrade head && python railway/bootstrap_admin.py'

PORT.description: Port uvicorn listens on (0.0.0.0). Railway routes the domain and the healthcheck here.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED. OpenAI (or OpenAI-compatible, see OPENAI_BASE_URL) key for memory extraction and embeddings. The API does not boot without it.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Azure gateway, ...). Empty = api.openai.com.

MEM0_DEFAULT_LLM_MODEL.description: Model used to extract facts from conversations (upstream default). Can be changed later in the dashboard Configuration page.

MEM0_DEFAULT_EMBEDDER_MODEL.description: Embedding model (1536 dimensions, upstream default). Changing it after memories exist needs a new collection.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets you switch the LLM to Anthropic in the dashboard Configuration page (embeddings still need OpenAI or Gemini).

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets you switch the LLM and/or embedder to Gemini in the dashboard Configuration page.

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Private hostname of the pgvector Postgres service.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Postgres superuser (needed to create the vector extension and the app database).

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password, generated on the Postgres service.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database holding the pgvector memory and entity tables.

POSTGRES_COLLECTION_NAME.description: Table name of the memory embeddings.

APP_DB_NAME.description: Database for users, API keys, request logs and settings (created by the pre-deploy step, migrated by Alembic).

HISTORY_DB_PATH.description: SQLite file with the change history of every memory. Lives on the /app/history volume.

JWT_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard access and refresh tokens. Rotating it logs every dashboard user out.

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Server-wide admin key for scripts and agents: send it as the X-API-Key header. Per-user keys can be created in the dashboard.

AUTH_DISABLED.description: Keep false. true opens every endpoint without authentication (upstream: local development only).

DASHBOARD_URL.description: Public dashboard origin; the only origin allowed by the API's CORS policy.

MEM0_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login email of the dashboard admin created on first deploy (change it later under Settings). Empty = first visitor runs the setup wizard.

MEM0_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of that admin, generated at deploy. Only used while no user exists; change it later in the dashboard.

MEM0_ADMIN_NAME.description: Display name of the bootstrap admin.

MEM0_TELEMETRY.description: Upstream anonymous telemetry (PostHog, at most two events per install). Off in this template; set true to opt in.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for in-flight requests on redeploy.

PORT.description: Next.js port. Railway routes the domain and the /api/health healthcheck here.

HOSTNAME.description: Address Next.js binds to. Must not be the container hostname, or the healthcheck cannot connect.

NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.description: Public URL of the Mem0 API, called from the browser. Written into the bundle at container start.

API_INTERNAL_URL.description: Private URL the dashboard server uses (setup status, token refresh).

DASHBOARD_URL.description: Own public origin; an https origin makes the refresh-token cookie Secure.

NEXT_PUBLIC_INSTANCE_NAME.description: Name shown in the dashboard header.

APP_DB_NAME.description: App database that holds the request_logs table.

REQUEST_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete API request log rows older than this many days (upstream default 30).

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database for the pgvector memory tables (the app database mem0_app is created next to it by the API pre-deploy step).

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres (private network, no TLS).

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down
